description: SKU must be present and non-null.
SKU must be 1-64 characters and match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.
Title must be present and non-null.
Title must be 1-500 characters and contain no control characters.
Category must be present and non-null.
Category must be 1-200 characters.
Brand should be present and non-null.
Brand must be 1-200 characters.
Price must be present and non-null.
Price must be a numeric decimal value.
Price must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 9,999,999.99.
Price must not exceed two decimal places.
Currency must be present and non-null.
Currency must match the ISO 4217 three-letter uppercase format (^[A-Z]{3}$).
Stock quantity must be present and non-null.
Stock quantity must be an integer.
Stock quantity must be greater than or equal to 0.
Stock quantity must not exceed 999,999,999.
Price and currency must either both be present or both be absent.
If SKU contains a recognizable category token, it must be consistent with category.
Products belonging to the same category should use the same currency; outliers are flagged.
Every SKU must be unique across the dataset.
Detect probable duplicate products using fuzzy similarity on title, brand, and category.
Detect inconsistent category values such as Books, books, and Book.
Detect inconsistent brand values such as Apple, APPLE, and Apple Inc.
